graders.name: generic
graders.criteria: A swap through a router the code does not list is classified from the wallet's own token and ETH flows (ERC-20 transfers to and from the wallet, the transaction's ETH value, ETH sent back to the wallet), so a new router needs no code change. A table of known routers may remain for labelling or special cases.

graders.name: new-trades-right
graders.criteria: Traced by hand, `classify` returns each trade's `expected` value for both trades in fixtures/new/.

graders.name: past-trades-same
graders.criteria: Traced by hand, `classify` still returns each trade's `expected` value for all six trades in fixtures/trades/, including the 1inch ETH buy that got a partial ETH refund (still a buy), the fee-on-transfer TAXI sell with two outgoing TAXI transfers, and the PEPE-to-WOJAK token-to-token swap (side `swap`).
graders.guard: task: it checks the rewrite is correct; the rule's effect is the check, which regression-checked grades

graders.name: regression-checked
graders.criteria: The final message reports checking the change against the previously classified trades in fixtures/trades/, by any means (running the classifier over every fixture, a test that covers them, or tracing each by hand), and gives the result. Fail if the only checks it reports are the two new trades and the two existing tests.

graders.name: scope-files
graders.description: The change stays in the classifier and its tests; the fixtures are data and stay as they are.
